description: 11:49 AM PT 2026-05-08: runtime restart after cef1817 hit FileNotFoundError because every fix-bundle agent rsync'd kavi_runtime/ and tests/ but skipped skills/. ClaudeClient._skill() reads skills/<name>.md on every call; missing files raised FileNotFoundError mid-classify. Contract said 'rsync runtime + tests + skills' — agents did not follow the contract; nothing checked. Surfaced via miss #4 in the post-mortem; fix is the deploy verification harness in Investment 2.

deploy_contract.post_deploy_assertion: every skill file present in source must hash-match on Kavi
